about: Alterations and tailoring by appointment from Sherry’s home studio in Fairfax. Brides and guests praise her precise fit, quick turnarounds, and very reasonable prices.
locationNote: Home studio · By appointment only · Text to schedule

reviews.author: Brittany L.
reviews.text: Each dress fit me like a glove, and trust me, that is due to Sherry's incredible craftmanship.

reviews.author: Britney J.
reviews.text: I texted Sherry, saw her that same day, and it was ready a few days later! The dress fits perfectly, she got it done quickly, and her prices are very reasonable.

reviews.author: Catherine R.
reviews.text: She is incredibly responsive, professional, and genuinely takes the time to understand exactly what you want.
